home.title: OSRS Events
home.description: The Old School RuneScape events platform for your clan. Create boards, roll dice and complete tasks together — login with Discord to get started.
home.how_subtitle: Everything you need to run OSRS events with your clan — all in one place.
home.feature_discord_desc: Log in with your Discord account. No passwords needed — your progress is saved automatically.
home.feature_boards_desc: Admins create Snakes & Ladders boards of any size (5×5, 7×7, 9×9) and assign OSRS tasks to every tile.
home.feature_dice_desc: Roll a d6 each day to advance across the board. Configurable daily roll limits keep things competitive.
home.feature_tasks_desc: Every tile links to an OSRS task. Search the wiki directly to auto-fill task icons and titles.
home.feature_snakes_desc: Land on a ladder to jump ahead, or hit a snake and slide back. Every board is unique.
home.feature_profile_desc: Track your progress, completed tiles and boards. Set a custom display name separate from your Discord username.
home.admin_subtitle: Manage boards, tasks and players from your admin dashboard.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: An OSRS-themed events platform for clans, made with love for the community.
about.feature_boards_desc: Admins create event boards of any size and assign OSRS tasks to every tile.
about.feature_dice_desc: Roll a d6 each day and advance across the board. Roll limits keep things competitive.
about.feature_tasks_desc: Every tile has an OSRS task. Complete it in-game and mark it done to unlock your next roll.
about.feature_discord_desc: No passwords needed — log in with your Discord account and your progress is saved automatically.
about.feature_dark_desc: Easy on the eyes whether you grind at noon or 2 AM. Dark mode is always available.
about.feature_free_desc: No premium tiers, no paywalls. Everything is free. If you enjoy it, consider a donation!
about.privacy_body: We only collect the minimum data needed to run the platform — your Discord username, ID and avatar. We do not track you, show you ads, or sell your data to anyone. Full details are in our Privacy Policy.
about.free_body: This project is run by a player, for players. Hosting and maintenance cost real money, so if you find value in the platform, a small donation helps keep the lights on.
about.support_body: Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature? Send us an email and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
about.disclaimer_body: OSRS Events is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Jagex Ltd. Old School RuneScape is a trademark of Jagex Ltd.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We believe your data is yours. Here is exactly what we collect and why.
privacy.intro_body: OSRS Events ("the Service") is a fan-made web application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about what little data we store. This page explains what information is collected when you use the Service, how it is used, and your rights.
privacy.data_intro: When you log in with Discord, we receive the following information from Discord's OAuth2 API:
privacy.data_discord_id_desc: Your unique Discord identifier. Used to link your account across sessions and to identify you within the game.
privacy.data_username_desc: Your Discord username at the time of login. Displayed on your profile and to other players on shared boards.
privacy.data_avatar_desc: A link to your Discord profile picture. Shown on your profile card and as your token on the game board.
privacy.data_nickname_desc: A custom display name you may set yourself in your profile. Replaces your Discord username wherever your name appears.
privacy.data_progress_desc: Your current tile position, completed tiles, and daily dice roll count on each board you participate in.
privacy.no_collect_body: We intentionally collect as little as possible. The following data is never collected:
privacy.no_analytics: Analytics, page views, or behavioural tracking
privacy.no_sell: Any data sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes
privacy.storage_body: Your data is stored in a private PostgreSQL database. A JSON Web Token (JWT) is saved in your browser's localStorage to keep you logged in for up to 7 days. This token contains only your user ID and is never shared with third parties. You can clear it at any time by logging out.
privacy.third_party_body: We use one external service as part of the login flow:
privacy.discord_note: Discord is used solely for authentication. Once logged in, we do not send any further data to Discord. Discord may log the OAuth2 authorisation request on their end.
privacy.rights_body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete the data we hold about you at any time. Logging out removes your local session token. To request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data, please contact us.
privacy.rights_contact_body: Send us an email with the subject 'Account deletion request' and we will remove your account and all associated data within a reasonable timeframe.
privacy.changes_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be announced via our Discord server. Continued use of the Service after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

terms.acceptance_body: By accessing or using OSRS Events ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use the Service.
terms.service_body: OSRS Events is a free, fan-made web application that allows Old School RuneScape players to participate in themed events and Snakes & Ladders competitions. The Service is provided as-is, for entertainment purposes, and is not affiliated with Jagex Ltd.
terms.accounts_body: To use the Service you must authenticate via a valid Discord account. By doing so you agree that:
terms.account_rule_discord: You have permission to use the Discord account you log in with.
terms.account_rule_one: You will only maintain one account per person.
terms.account_rule_accurate: The information provided via Discord (username, avatar) is accurate to your Discord account.
terms.conduct_body: You agree not to use the Service in any way that:

terms.conduct_rule_scrape: Scrapes, crawls, or programmatically harvests data without permission.

terms.ip_body: The code and design of this platform are the work of its creators. Old School RuneScape content (including task names, item icons and game imagery) belongs to Jagex Ltd. and is used here under fan content guidelines.

donate.title: Support Us
donate.subtitle: OSRS Events is free — and always will be. But hosting costs gold coins too.
donate.intro: Running this platform takes time and money. If you enjoy it and want to help keep it going, here are two ways to show your support — one real, one very RuneScape.
donate.kofi_desc: Ko-fi lets you send a small one-time tip (like buying someone a coffee). No subscription required — any amount is greatly appreciated and goes directly towards server costs.
donate.kofi_button: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
donate.gp_desc: Prefer to tip in Gielinor's finest currency? We will genuinely accept it. No, it will not pay any real bills. But it will warm our heart and give us a reason to log in.
donate.gp_warning: GP is accepted purely as a gesture of goodwill. We cannot guarantee any response time — the developer may be AFK at Lumbridge.
donate.gp_how_desc: Send us an email with the subject "GP Donation" and we'll meet you in-game!
donate.thanks_body: Whether you donate or not, thank you for playing. Every player who joins a board and enjoys the game makes this project worthwhile. See you in Gielinor! 🗡️
